input.source: user-provided lawful dump, kept outside git

X0.note: User-provided external retail XEX hash and title identity verified; no game binary or assets are tracked

X1.note: SDK v0.10.0 is pinned; eighteen live-memory-derived function entries have focused static regressions. ReXGlue codegen and Linux AMD64 build now accept the 68-byte 0x82341198 dispatcher; its runtime execution and the broader PPC/import/lowering report remain open.

X2.note: The plugin-enabled Linux AMD64 probe verified the retail VdEnableRingBufferRPtrWriteBack call with physical address 0x17AF403C and block-size log2 6. The GPU worker advanced the big-endian readback at descriptor+0x3C through values 25, 49, and 73; exact-XEX helper 0x823B2920 reads that +0x3C field. A clean follow-up GDB run watched the distinct descriptor+0x00 word, object+0x2ABD predicate, current KTHREAD+0x58 and object+13432: the queue stayed at 1, predicate at 0x14, and the two fields at zero; retail helper 0x823B33A0 was not entered during the observed interval. The timeout helper 0x823BA9C8 traps when object+13432 is null, so fabricating its trigger is not a valid fix. Runtime evidence confirms PM4_INTERRUPT source r3=1 reaches retail callback 0x823B37B8; source 0 in that guest callback leads to 0x823A4640, the deferred callback queue handler. A later Android run (log nfs_shift_034, hash in evidence/xbox360_android_vblank_callback_probe_20261024.json) confirms the selected shift-native plugin dispatches three source-0 vblank callbacks at 60 Hz, plus one PM4_INTERRUPT callback. It still ends after two swaps and 1602 PM4 packets; the guest software queue head and predicate were not watched in that Android run, so source-0 delivery is confirmed but its effect on the wait is not. Exact 0x58 EVENT_WRITE_SHD packet bytes and destinations are being captured by Process 2. Preserve retail queue semantics until the packet target and guest state transition are verified.

X3.note: Process 2 Linux evidence reports 1,828 retail PM4 packets, two guest swaps, 48 submitted retail point-list draws, and two Vulkan frame submissions. Its latest Android log also records three vblank source-0 callback dispatches and one PM4_INTERRUPT callback, but no later ring batch after 1602 packets and two swaps. The retail queue state was not watched during that Android run. The captured retail pixel shader readback and game window remain black in the separately documented Android output check; a synthetic magenta diagnostic is not parity evidence. Frontend, visible retail output, and scene parity remain unverified.

X4.note: The user confirmed that the original game's loading screen appeared during a ReXGlue Xbox run. The exact process/build hash was not recorded and the screen is no longer visible. Current controlled evidence remains at the guest ring/callback wait, and the captured Linux window is black. The main menu, retail frame, and offline race remain unverified.

X5.note: No SHIFT Xbox runtime execution on target architectures

X6.note: Source audit found a Vulkan 1.1 path but three optional feature bits are hard requirements; device feature probe and retail draw/present proof are pending
